## Goal

Implement gh-67 (quick round): init/upgrade create the labels norn uses (GR10), doctor warns about missing/unused ones (A7), triage sets kind/risk/priority labels (GR11); docs.

## Progress

- Refine round (round 1): spec B1–B30 written and agreed; RULES GR10, GR11, A7 amended.
- RemotePort gains `listLabels()` and `createLabel()` (`_exists` PortError on a taken name); gh and glab adapters, scripted CLIs, contract tests (+4), FakeRemote (`labels`, `listLabelsError`, `createLabelError`), gh/glab argv unit tests.
- Pure plan in `packages/core/src/labels.ts` (`planLabels`, `TRIAGE_LABELS`, `NORN_LABEL_COLOR`, create/delete commands) + unit test.
- `packages/cli/src/runtime/labels.ts` (`remoteLabels`, create or check mode; never throws for the remote) wired into init (row `labels`, gh label create hint dropped, B29), upgrade (every run, also "already on" message), doctor (warnings only, not under `--repo`).
- CLI-seam tests: `packages/cli/test/integration/labels.test.ts` (B1, B2, B5, B7, B8, B10–B19, B29). Four existing tests updated for the new `labels` JSON key.
- Triage: the craft skill must not name norn (P7, assets test), so `norn-triage` describes the three sets generically and the triage workflows' instructions (shipped + repo copy) name the `norn:*` labels and "norn upgrade creates it".
- Docs: README (init creates labels, no `gh label create`), concepts.md new "Labels" section, recipes (upgrade for a new workflow's label), CONTRIBUTING labels table.
- Decisions: workflow label descriptions are clipped to 100 characters (GitHub's limit; quick's is longer); an invalid workflow's existing label is not called unused; glab lists one page of 100 labels, a label beyond it is caught as `_exists` on create; GitLab parity (B3, B28) is covered at the port contract and command level, not by a CLI test (FakeRemote is gh-only).
- implement#1 done: GR10/GR11 built: RemotePort listLabels/createLabel (gh, glab, fake, contract); init and upgrade create the missing norn, norn:wf:* and triage labels, never edit or delete, report without failing; doctor warns (not under --repo); the triage skill and workflows set kind/risk/priority labels, keeping existing ones; docs updated. Unit, integration and typecheck green.
